conclusion: The defect is not merely missing enumeration. Forge lacks an authoritative independent core-side validation/transaction boundary for the returned combat-damage allocation.
existing_core_rule_primitives: assignedDamageMap for already assigned same-step damage
negative_cases_currently_not_independent: sum less than source combat damage
sum greater than source combat damage
trample spill to defender before blocker lethal
illegal defender/player spill without a modifying rule
legacy-order violation when legacy order mode is enabled

proof: Combat.assignAttackersDamage and assignBlockersDamage call PlayerController.assignCombatDamage and then ingest each map entry directly into addAssignedDamage/damageMap.
No comprehensive validation step rejects an under-assigned, over-assigned, illegal-recipient, illegal-trample-spill or otherwise malformed returned allocation before state mutation.
Combat.dealAssignedDamage later deals the already accepted map; damage replacement/prevention is not an assignment-legality validator.
